Every F7 upstream Pareto set and the F8 robust set are therefore 'Pareto within the F3 front-union subset': the A9.7 consolidated-verification evidence for INT-01 (a re-run over the then 48 gate-passing designs) reported 9 of the 10 nominal contexts changing (members added, and some committed members dominated by an excluded design, e.g. T4-A0-U2-D0).
